description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that functions as an interface for logging messages within an Android application, allowing logs to be directed through a chain of LogNode objects. It provides static methods for various log levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), encapsulating the native Android Log utility, and offers a way to set and retrieve log nodes for flexible logging configurations.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class that mimics Android's Log class, routing log messages through a chain of LogNode objects and providing static methods for logging at different levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to handle log outputs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (critical) message, optionally with Throwable.
